agent.error.cdp_no_content_length: CDP didn't report the response size
agent.error.chromium_not_downloaded: Chromium hasn't been downloaded yet. Ask to open the Browser tab and download it.
agent.error.chromium_start_timeout: Chromium didn't start in time; try again in a few seconds.
agent.error.empty_page_list: CDP's page list came back empty
agent.error.no_browser_tab: No Browser tab is open. Use browser_open with the URL to open one.

agent.error.no_project_window: No window of this project is open

agent.error.tab_closed_before_load: The Browser tab closed before the page loaded
agent.error.tab_hidden: The Browser tab is hidden in the Devices panel, and a hidden page doesn't paint or receive input. Ask to show it; browser_eval works anyway.
agent.error.tab_not_on_screen: The Browser tab didn't appear on screen, and Chromium only starts once it does. Ask to make it visible.
agent.error.timed_out: {action}: the browser didn't respond in time
agent.page_hidden_suffix: (the tab is hidden in the Devices panel)
agent.tool.key: Pressed a key in the page
agent.tool.open: Opened a page in the browser
agent.toolkit_description: The embedded Chromium (Browser and Devices tabs)
error.no_frame_detail: Chromium started but painted nothing within {seconds} seconds, which usually means its renderer process failed to launch. The Zed log has the web_preview entries with the reason.
error.no_frame_headline: The browser never rendered a frame
import.bookmarks_detail: Shown on the new tab, without duplicating the ones already here
import.card_description: Import bookmarks and sessions from the browser you already use: sites open logged in, without typing passwords again.
import.cookies_detail: You stay logged in where you already were
import.done_note: Banks and Google accounts often tie the login to the browser it came from. If a site asks you to log in, do it once here.
import.done_summary: {bookmarks} new bookmarks and {cookies} cookies came from {source}.
import.full_disk_detail: macOS only hands Safari's bookmarks and cookies to apps with Full Disk Access. Turn Asylum on under System Settings › Privacy & Security › Full Disk Access, then reopen Asylum.
import.keychain_denied: macOS did not hand over the key that unlocks the sessions, so only the bookmarks came. Try again and allow access to the Keychain.
import.keychain_note: macOS will ask for your password to release the “{service}” key. Saved passwords are not imported: they stay in your password manager.
import.none_description: Chrome, Arc, Brave, Edge and Firefox profiles are looked for in their usual folders. Safari comes later.
import.passwords_note: Saved passwords are not imported: they stay in your password manager.
import.title: Import from another browser
install.detail_installed: Open a page to get started.
install.detail_missing: About 120 MB is downloaded once and kept for later.
load_error.headline: {host} didn't load
load_error.refused_detail: No server is listening on that port. If it runs in one of the project's terminals, check that it's still up.
start.empty_description: Type an address above. Dev servers running on this machine show up here.
unsupported.detail: For now the embedded browser only works on macOS.
unsupported.headline: Web Preview isn't available on this system yet
